quick_facts.sprint_goal: Polish the demo experience (print invoice, toasts, skeleton loaders) and deliver the reporting backend so accountants can close the month.

content.tldr: Two tracks: (1) frontend UX polish — print invoice, notification toasts, loading skeletons, dashboard home page; (2) reporting backend — daily/monthly revenue + VAT API, CSV export endpoint.

features_committed.title: UX Polish (Frontend)
features_committed.rationale: Demo experience requires professional polish. Error states, loading feedback, and invoice print are table-stakes for a customer-facing demo.
tasks: T023: Toast/notification system (react-hot-toast or shadcn Toaster) — wire to all mutation success/error
T024: Skeleton loaders for product list, orders list, invoices list
T025: Error boundary component (catches unhandled errors, shows friendly Vietnamese message)
T026: Invoice print view — /invoices/:id/print — formatted for A4, hóa đơn layout, no nav
T027: Print button on InvoiceDetailPage → window.print() with print-only CSS
T028: Dashboard home page /dashboard — KPI cards: revenue today (VNĐ), orders today, invoices issued, active products

features_committed.title: Reporting Backend
features_committed.rationale: Accountants need monthly/daily summaries for Vietnamese tax authority. This is a legal requirement.
tasks: T029: ReportingModule created. GET /reports/daily?date=YYYY-MM-DD — revenue, tax totals, invoice count per store
T030: GET /reports/monthly?year=YYYY&month=MM — monthly aggregate same shape
T033: 15+ unit tests for ReportingService (daily/monthly calc, CSV generation)

also_this_sprint: Add /dashboard as default landing for store-manager role
Vitest test for AppLayout role-based nav rendering (from Sprint 4 retrospective)
Add breadcrumb navigation to all inner pages
prerequisites: Sprint 4: Store UI + User UI complete

audit.author: vibe-project-manager
audit.note: Sprint 5 planned. Two parallel tracks: UX polish (frontend-first) + reporting backend.
